name: Peraturan.id (BPK regulation database)
notes: Live JDIH BPK regulation database of Indonesia's Badan Pemeriksa Keuangan, stating free access 'dapat diakses oleh Pelaksana BPK maupun masyarakat umum secara gratis dan tanpa syarat.' Only a disclaimer page exists (documents sourced from official institution websites; users told to verify discrepancies with the issuing agency); no copyright notice, open-licence statement or reuse policy is published. Full text is openly readable, so access=open is right, but reuse terms are unstated and licence stays unknown. Evidence: https://peraturan.bpk.go.id (read 2026-11-12)
